four_term_nonlinear_gbt_vs_served.classification_evidence: Whole season-block interval below zero (P+ 0.0001); decisive games served 110-91 on 201; Brier and log loss worse (P+ of worse 0.94); shallow trees on these four inputs lose out of season
four_term_nonlinear_gbt_vs_served.description: Gradient-boosted trees (depth 2, 100 iterations, lr 0.05, leaf 50, fixed a priori) on the same four served inputs vs the served ridge logistic, LOSO 2020-2025, 1,503 opener-graded games
four_term_nonlinear_gbt_vs_served.plain_summary: A tree model on the same four inputs picked worse than the current fitted probability out of season.

four_term_pairwise_interactions_vs_serve.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero; decisive games served 36-34 on 70; Brier interval crosses zero
four_term_pairwise_interactions_vs_serve.description: Served ridge logistic plus the six pairwise interactions of its four standardized terms (ridge fixed), LOSO 2020-2025 vs the served base on 1,503 games
four_term_pairwise_interactions_vs_serve.plain_summary: Adding interactions between the four inputs did not pick better; the difference is within noise.
